items.rationale: The model is stateless; the program rebuilds the input every call, so the model knows only what is in it. Option b is the 'model remembers' mix-up.

Results accumulate and the whole context is re-sent each call: call 1 sends 1,000, call 2 sends 1,500, call 3 sends 2,000, total 4,500. An answer of 3,000 or 2,000 forgets that earlier content is re-sent.
Memory across sessions is information saved outside the model and loaded into the next context. A larger window or longer prompt does not persist anything.
